## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Include a minimal before/after
example when useful.

## Verification

List the commands actually run and their results. For renderer or layout changes,
include reviewed color/grayscale previews and mention any remaining readability
limits. A geometry pass alone is not visual acceptance.

- [ ] Project content is in English; `npm run check:repo` passes.
- [ ] Appropriate tests pass, with a regression for a reproduced bug when needed.
- [ ] Changed syntax and behavior are documented.
- [ ] Generated previews are updated if source or visible rendering changed.
- [ ] No build output or local package archives are tracked.
